instruction: pagination.py has off-by-one bugs. Pages are 1-indexed. `page_count(total, per_page)` must return the number of pages needed (0 when total is 0; exact multiples must not produce an extra empty page). `get_page(items, page, per_page)` must return the items on that 1-indexed page, the last page may be shorter, and a page past the end (or page < 1) returns []. `per_page < 1` must raise ValueError in both functions. Do not change the function signatures. All tests in tests/test_pagination.py must pass.
